'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Seven [[Chad National Army|Chadian soldiers]] conducting a [[patrol]] near [[Lake Chad]] are killed in an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] bombing. '''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[United Nations Security Council Resolution 2728]]
***The [[UN Security Council]] passes a resolution calling for an immediate [[ceasefire]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] and the release of [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages held]] by [[Hamas]], with the [[United States]] abstaining. [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] cancels a planned visit to the U.S. in response to the abstention. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-security-council-demands-immediate-ceasefire-gaza-2024-03-25/ (Reuters)]
